title: Dummy Backend Todos with React Query
description: Use @tanstack/react-query to load todos from the dummy backend, display them with filters, and expose a manual refetch control.
requirements: Use useQuery from @tanstack/react-query to fetch todos from http://localhost:4000/api/todos with a stable queryKey
While loading, render a div with class 'todos-query-panel loading' containing text 'Loading todos...'
On error, render a div with class 'todos-query-panel error' showing 'Error: <message>' and a 'Retry' button that calls refetch
In the success state, render a div with class 'todos-query-panel loaded' containing an h1 'Todos (React Query)' and a 'Refresh todos' button that calls refetch
Display todos in a ul with class 'todo-list' where each li has class 'todo-item' and shows the todo title
Add three filter buttons: All, Active, Completed; clicking them filters the visible todos by completed flag and visually marks the active filter with class 'active'
Show an element with class 'empty' and text 'No todos match this filter.' when the filtered list is empty

hints.query: Use useQuery({ queryKey: ['dummy-todos'], queryFn: fetchTodos }) and destructure isLoading, isError, error, refetch.
hints.filtering: Filter based on the completed boolean; 'Active' means not completed.
hints.empty: When filtered.length === 0, show a short empty state message instead of an empty list.
